module: Fast serializer/deserializer of Lua values (tables, numbers, strings, booleans, vec3, quat) to compact strings, used to exchange data between VMs (GE <-> vehicle) and for saving. Three formats: proprietary text ('a...~'), binary based on string.buffer ('b...'), and Lua source (encodeLua). decode automatically recognizes text or binary. An array of doubles can also be packed at 8 bytes per value.
usage:
local s = lpack.encode({a = 1, b = {1, 2, 3}, pos = vec3(1, 2, 3)})
local t = lpack.decode(s)
-- binaire :
local sb = lpack.encodeBin(t)
local t2 = lpack.decode(sb)
notes: SECURITY: decodeLua(s) executes loadstring('return ' .. s)(): only call it with trusted data (produced by encodeLua), never with external text.

decode(is, target): `is` can be a string or a string.buffer. If the data is in binary format ('b'), `target` allows decoding "in place" into an existing table/vec3/quat to avoid allocations (the target table is cleared then filled). For the text format, target is ignored.
encode(nil) and encodeBin(nil) return ''; decode('') and decode(nil) return nil. The garbage collector is stopped during decode then restarted.

encodeBinWorkBuffer returns the module's shared INTERNAL string.buffer (bufTmp), not a string: its content is overwritten on the next call of encodeBin/encodeLua/encodeBinWorkBuffer. Consume it immediately.

encodeDoubleArray(tbl): packs the elements tbl[1..n] (and tbl[0] if it exists) into little-endian doubles; decodeDoubleArray(sda, tbl) does the reverse, filling tbl[1..n] (the input element at index 0 is not restored at index 0 but at 1: shift).

The text format encodes numbers as 'sign + absolute value' (prefix '-' positive, '=' negative) and infinities/NaN are malformed in the code ('-9e+999' for v >= 0 and '=9e+999' for v < 0): NaNs are therefore decoded as +infinity.

encode.desc: Serializes v in the compact text format (start 'a', end '~'). Returns '' if v is nil.

v.desc: Lua value (table, number, string, boolean, vec3, quat)

decode.desc: Deserializes a value produced by encode or encodeBin (detects the format from the first character: 'b' = binary). Accepts a string or a string.buffer.

target.desc: object to fill in place (binary format only)

returns.desc: decoded value, nil if input is empty

encodeBin.desc: Serializes v in binary format (string.buffer encode, prefix 'b') with special types for vec3 and quat. Returns '' if nil.

encodeBinWorkBuffer.desc: Like encodeBin but returns the module's shared work buffer instead of a string (zero copy). The content is overwritten on the next call.

returns.desc: work buffer (or '' if v is nil)

encodeLua.desc: Serializes v as Lua source text (strings with %q, tables with brackets for non-sequential keys) to be read back with decodeLua.

decodeLua.desc: Evaluates a string produced by encodeLua (loadstring('return '..s)()). Dangerous with untrusted data. Returns nil if s is nil.

encodeDoubleArray.desc: Converts an array of numbers into a binary string of doubles (8 bytes per value, via ffi).

tbl.desc: array of numbers (index 0 included if it exists)

decodeDoubleArray.desc: Converts a string of doubles (8 bytes each, little-endian) into a Lua array. Fills tbl if given.

tbl.desc: destination table, new table if nil
